kpis.quote: Segment revenues increased $4.6 million to $9.7 million, compared to $5.1 million in the second quarter of 2025.
Mineral resources segment revenues increased 20% to $1.8 million, compared to $1.5 million in the second quarter of 2025.
Farming segment revenues were $0.8 million, compared to $0.6 million in the second quarter of 2025.

kpis.kpi: Net income attributable to common stockholders
kpis.quote: Net income attributable to common stockholders increased by $4.3 million to $2.6 million ($0.10/ share basic and diluted), compared to a loss of $1.7 million.
Net income (loss) per share attributable to common stockholders, basic | $0.10 | $(0.06) | $0.10 | $(0.12)
Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, increased by $2.7 million to $8.4 million compared to $5.7 million in the second quarter of 2025.

kpis.kpi: Commercial/industrial real estate costs and expenses

guidance.text: The company expects to continue pursuing commercial and industrial development directly and through joint ventures, including opportunistic land sales.
guidance.quote: The Company expects to continue to pursue commercial and industrial development both directly and through joint ventures, including opportunistic land sales.

guidance.text: Net income is expected to fluctuate with land-sale timing, leasing activity, and commodity prices.
guidance.quote: Net income will fluctuate with the timing of land sales, leasing activity, and commodity prices.

data.summary: Tejon Ranch reported higher second-quarter revenue, profitability, EPS, and Adjusted EBITDA, with commercial/industrial real estate the largest revenue contributor. Results also benefited from lower corporate expenses, while management continued to advance commercial, industrial, and residential development opportunities.
